description: A duration parser converts hours with the wrong multiplier; the repo's own test suite is red on arrival.
prompt: The tests in this repository are failing. `parseDuration` in src/duration.js is supposed to turn a duration string like "1h30m", "90m" or "45s" into a number of milliseconds, but it converts hours with the wrong multiplier. Fix src/duration.js so every unit converts correctly and `npm test` passes. Do not change any file under test/.
